evals.name: nus-software-engineer-technical-screen
evals.profile: NUS Computer Science final-year student applying for a Singapore software engineering graduate role
evals.prompt: 我是 NUS Computer Science 大四学生，要面试新加坡 Software Engineer Graduate Programme。简历只写了 Python、Java 和一个课程 web app，没有写 distributed systems。请用 coaching mode 模拟 live coding 面试，一次一题。遇到算法题不要直接给我答案；先等我澄清、讲思路、复杂度和测试。也请检查我有没有把 JD 里的 distributed systems 说成自己的经验。
expectations: Routes to a software-engineering technical interview rather than a generic behavioural interview
Asks one question at a time and does not reveal the solution before the candidate attempts it
Prompts the candidate to clarify requirements and state assumptions
Evaluates approach, correctness, time and space complexity, edge cases and tests
Includes debugging or follow-up probing appropriate to a live coding round
Does not turn the JD's distributed-systems requirement into candidate experience
Uses English for interview questions and candidate-ready examples with Chinese coaching
Scores technical reasoning and communication without inventing evidence

evals.name: ntu-data-analyst-sql-case
evals.profile: NTU Business Analytics student applying for a marketplace Data Analyst internship
evals.prompt: 我是 NTU Business Analytics 大三，申请电商 Data Analyst internship。我的真实经历只有 Python 清洗公开数据和 Tableau dashboard，没在工作里用过 SQL。请模拟一个订单转化率下降的 analytics case，先让我答，不要把 SQL 写成我的经历。反馈时请看我有没有定义 metric、确认数据粒度、处理 null/duplicate、验证结论并说明 business implication。
expectations: Routes to a data and analytics case
Requires a precise metric definition and denominator before analysis
Checks data grain, joins, nulls, duplicates and other data-quality risks
Evaluates validation, segmentation and business implications rather than only syntax
Does not claim the candidate has workplace SQL experience
Separates case facts, candidate assumptions and hypotheses
Uses adaptive follow-up questions based on the candidate's reasoning

evals.name: smu-consulting-candidate-led-case
evals.profile: SMU Economics student applying for a strategy consulting internship
evals.prompt: 我是 SMU Economics 大四，准备新加坡 consulting internship 的 candidate-led case。请给我一个东南亚咖啡连锁利润下降的 case，一次只推进一个阶段。不要替我编市场规模。看我是否会澄清目标、搭结构、提出 hypothesis、检查计算单位，并在最后做 recommendation、risks 和 next steps。
expectations: Runs a candidate-led case rather than an interviewer-led sequence
Waits for clarification and structure before releasing further case information
Evaluates issue-tree quality and hypothesis-driven prioritisation
Checks calculations, units and interpretation of results
Does not invent market size or external facts not supplied in the case
Requires a concise synthesis with recommendation, evidence, risks and next steps
Separates coaching mode from realistic interview mode

evals.name: nus-product-manager-product-sense
evals.profile: NUS Industrial Design student transitioning toward product management
evals.prompt: 我是 NUS Industrial Design 学生，想申请 Associate Product Manager。我做过一次校园导航 redesign，但从没正式当过 PM。请模拟 product sense 面试，题目是如何改善新生第一周的校园导航体验。不要把我包装成有 PM 工作经验。反馈要看 user segment、pain point、business goal、success metric、prioritisation、trade-off 和 experiment。
expectations: Routes to a product-sense interview with an appropriate product framework
Requires a target user segment and validated pain point
Connects user value to an explicit product or business goal
Requires measurable success metrics and guardrail metrics
Evaluates prioritisation, trade-offs and experiment design
Does not rename the candidate as a Product Manager or invent PM employment
Uses the real redesign project only when the candidate supplies evidence

evals.name: smu-finance-risk-technical-ethics
evals.profile: SMU Applied Finance master's student applying for a bank Risk Analyst role
evals.prompt: 我是 SMU MSc Applied Finance，申请新加坡银行 Risk Analyst。真实经历是三年 credit analysis、Excel model 和监控 RMB 80M portfolio。请模拟 technical + ethics panel，覆盖 credit risk、scenario analysis、model limitation 和发现同事绕过 control 时怎么办。若需要最新银行或监管信息，请先核实，不要临场编新闻或法规。
expectations: Routes to a finance and risk technical panel
Tests credit-risk reasoning, scenario analysis and model limitations
Includes an ethics or control-escalation scenario
Preserves the supplied RMB 80M fact without joining it to unsupported facts
Requires the candidate to disclose uncertainty rather than bluff
Verifies time-sensitive company, market or regulatory facts before using them
Assesses commercial impact and control judgement separately

evals.name: ntu-operations-graduate-panel
evals.profile: NTU engineering graduate with National Service leadership applying for an operations programme
evals.round: HR screen followed by panel behavioural interview
evals.prompt: 我是 NTU 应届生，NS 时是 3SG，带过 8 人小队并做每周训练计划，申请 Operations Graduate Programme。请先做 3 题 realistic mode HR screen，再做 panel behavioural。不要每题后立刻教学，整轮结束再反馈；重点看 leadership、conflict、resilience 和 operational judgement。
expectations: Honours realistic mode by withholding coaching until the round ends
Separates HR-screen and panel objectives
Uses the verified 3SG and team-of-eight evidence without inventing branch or unit
Covers leadership, conflict, resilience and operational judgement
Maintains one-question-at-a-time interaction with adaptive probing
Produces a structured end-of-round report with scores and next actions

evals.name: marketing-growth-campaign-case
evals.profile: SIM marketing student applying for a Growth Marketing internship
evals.prompt: 我是 SIM Marketing 学生，申请 Growth Marketing internship。项目里做过 Instagram 内容和一份 campaign proposal，但没有真实投放预算或 conversion 数据。请模拟 portfolio + campaign case。不要替我编 reach、CTR、CAC 或 ROI；反馈时看 objective、audience、channel choice、funnel metric、attribution 和 learning。
expectations: Routes to a marketing portfolio and campaign case
Requires objective, target audience and channel rationale
Evaluates funnel metrics and attribution limitations
Does not invent reach, CTR, CAC, ROI, budget or conversion data
Distinguishes a proposal from an executed campaign
Rewards reflection and learning without fabricating impact

evals.name: ux-research-portfolio-interview
evals.profile: SUTD student applying for a UX Research internship
evals.prompt: 我是 SUTD 学生，申请 UX Research internship。课程项目访谈了 6 名同学，做了 affinity mapping 和 prototype test，但没有上线产品。请模拟 portfolio walkthrough 和 research-method interview。不要把课程项目说成商业项目，也不要编上线结果；看我有没有讲清 problem、method choice、evidence、decision、limitation 和 next step。
expectations: Routes to a UX research portfolio walkthrough
Requires problem, method choice, evidence, decision and reflection
Preserves six participants and does not invent sample size or product launch
Distinguishes a course project from commercial work
Tests research limitations, bias, privacy and next steps
Assesses storytelling and research judgement separately

evals.name: nus-phd-biomedical-rd-deep-dive
evals.profile: NUS Biomedical Engineering PhD applying for a medical-device R&D role
evals.round: Technical deep dive with cross-functional panel
evals.prompt: 我是 NUS Biomedical Engineering PhD，申请医疗器械 R&D。研究是 electrospun nanofibers，并与 NUH clinicians 做临床前研究；没有可公开病人数量或性能提升百分比。请模拟 technical deep dive 和面向非技术 panel 的解释。不要把我的研究升级成已完成 medical-device development，也不要编 patient count、standards 或 validation result。
expectations: Routes to an R&D technical deep dive and cross-functional explanation
Preserves biomedical source accuracy and contribution level
Does not relabel the research as completed medical-device development
Does not invent patient counts, standards, validation results or performance metrics
Tests experimental design, limitations, safety and translation considerations
Requires both expert-level and non-technical explanations
Evaluates uncertainty handling and evidence boundaries

evals.name: nonlocal-hr-salary-work-auth-fairness
evals.profile: Chinese postgraduate applying for a Singapore business analyst role and requiring Employment Pass sponsorship
evals.prompt: 我是中国籍硕士，申请新加坡 Business Analyst，需要 Employment Pass sponsorship。请模拟 HR screen，练习 work authorisation、expected salary，以及面试官问‘你打算结婚生孩子吗’时怎么回应。不要替我判断 EP eligibility，也不要编市场薪资。请区分当前 TGFEP 和尚未生效的 WFA，不要把每个敏感问题都简单说成违法。
expectations: Uses only the verified Requires Employment Pass sponsorship wording
Does not claim Employment Pass eligibility or likely approval
Does not invent a market salary range and asks for current verified benchmarks
Helps the candidate answer the job-related concern without disclosing unnecessary personal information
Explains that non-job-related discriminatory questions should be avoided rather than declaring every sensitive question automatically illegal
Distinguishes current TGFEP guidance from the Workplace Fairness Act expected to take effect by end-2027
Offers a tactful relevance-clarification response and escalation option
Frames the guidance as practical information rather than personal legal advice
